units.source_text: 话刚落地，柏木连忙解开制服的胸扣，摸了摸里兜。

en.t: As soon as the words were out, Kashiwagi hurriedly unbuttoned the chest of his uniform and felt inside the inner pocket.

units.source_text: "回老家之前，我想让你高兴高兴，就把它带来了。

en.t: "Before going back home, I wanted to make you happy, so I brought it with me.

units.source_text: 你不是曾乱出高价把这家伙买来吗。"

en.t: After all, you once paid an absurdly high price to buy this thing, didn't you?"
